prompt: A workshop scene with a carpenter building furniture. The carpenter is standing at a workbench, holding a hammer and hammering a nail into a piece of wood. An open toolbox sits on the workbench next to the wood. The toolbox contains three nails, a group of screws, and some chisels. The number of screws is double the number of nails, and the number of chisels is one more than the number of nails. A saw is hanging from a pegboard on the wall behind the workbench. The carpenter is wearing safety glasses and pointing at a blueprint spread on a table next to the workbench. A newly finished wooden chair is positioned in front of the table. The chair is smaller than the workbench. The wood used for the chair is smoother than the rough piece of wood on the workbench. Wood shavings are scattered on the floor around the workbench. A drill is lying on the floor next to the wood shavings.
